Apply one ASPLOS27 rule-ablation transform to a single Pyrope .prp file. Rules currently implemented — `rename` (auto-gen identifiers → semantic names), `wire-to-const` (two-step `wire` decl → `const`/`mut`), `register-removal` (delete a `reg` whose only reads are self-referential), `band-fold` (stride-N scalar `_GEN_<base+stride*i>` wire bands → `[N]uW` array + for-loop), `cascade-fold` (per-entry `_mux_<N>` + `reg_arr[i]` writeback cascade → hybrid loop + N scalar reg writes), and `flatten-extract` (inline bit-vec OR flatteners `(arr[N-1] << k*(N-1)) \| ... \| arr[0]` → `_flat_<arr>:u<N*k>` helper + loop). Invoke with the rule name as first argument, then the target .prp path. One rule per invocation.
